code.sh: HTTP code representing the outcome of the status request.

cumulative.sh: If true, sum across bands so that a given band value is the sum of all preceding values plus the band value.

data_source.sh: A string value representing the cohort type

dimensions.sh: An array representing dimension(s) to group by.

enable_install_recalculation.sh: If true, then Branch will de-dupe unattributed installs caused by duplicate events from non-opt-in users coming from paid ads.

end_date.sh: The end of the interval time range represented as an ISO-8601 complete date.

error_message.sh: Error message if the query failed

granularity.sh: The time granularity that each band value will represent.

granularity_band_count.sh: Number of time units since the cohort event to return to the user.

job_id.sh: Unique identifier used to retrieve job status and data.

ordered.sh: Order of response based on ordered_by value.

per_user.sh: If true, divide each band value by the user count.

response_url.sh: S3 url for downloading the response data.

start_date.sh: The start of the interval time range represented as an ISO-8601 complete date.

status_url.sh: More information about the subscription's status.

unique.sh: Whether or not to return unique values.
